blindSummary:
In 2024 a trans woman was the victim of an attempted femicide (femicidio frustrado) in this state/province's main city. The tribunal imposed four years of internacion parcial against the five years of internacion total requested by the prosecution; the victim's mother publicly denounced the devaluation of the attack on the basis of her daughter's gender identity. In April 2026 the national women-and-gender-equality service's regional director publicly criticised the sentence as not reflecting the gravity of the attack and announced an appeal - an institutional counter-signal to the judicial under-penalisation. This state/province also appeared among the regions with the largest percentage increases in the 2024 dataset and holds 0.96 % of the national case total.

No traveler-facing enforcement action is documented for this state/province; the absolute case volume is the country's smallest (0.96 % of national reports), so the complaint machinery is rarely encountered at all.
